owner_direction: For proof that historical rider/race information was the pre-race information, trust information presented by official sites as racecard/entry/pre-race information. Use official sites as the base source so acquisition is not blocked by proving the original fetch occurred before the historical race.
authoritative_sources: official velodrome/organizer pages when the venue/date/race binding is explicit

accepted_when: race date, venue and rider identity are exact
field is explicitly presented in a racecard/entry/pre-race context
registration number is exact when available or is separately resolved from KEIRIN.JP by exact rider identity
result/payout/odds/forecast fields are not admitted into PRE features
not_accepted: current profile competition score/style/class silently backfilled into an old race
unofficial page used as sole authority for historical PRE semantics
result-derived or payout-derived fields reused as PRE

prohibited_for_historical_feature_backfi: current home-bank or preference as historical race feature

official_profile_capability_fresh_verifi.role: demonstrates official identity plus historical meeting participation can be screened directly from KEIRIN.JP
demonstrates official profile recent-history screening for an active candidate

consequence: Historical support acquisition no longer waits on proving that the historical official page itself was fetched before the historical PIT cutoff. Exact official historical race facts can be used for support screening/completion while target RESULT remains isolated.
supersession_note: This policy supersedes only the historical-source timing-proof requirement where an official source itself identifies the field as historical racecard/entry/pre-race information. It does not relax prospective pre-cutoff capture rules.
